_desc: S2: two engine=meshroute FirmwareNodes drive the real MeshRoute lib/core meshroute::Node via the meshroute::Hal, and exchange a raw placeholder frame across the real SimRadio channel. fw0 TXes at ~1s, fw1 at ~2s (id-staggered, no self-collision); each receives the other. Asserts both TX and both RX via the lib/core Node's mr_node_tx / mr_node_rx emits - proving the full Node -> Hal.tx -> SimRadio -> peer onRecv -> Node.on_recv path. Supersedes the S1 t82 skeleton.
